_README: Accepted divergences between Chrome's font selection and Domotion's, consumed by tools/font-conformance.ts.
An entry here suppresses a real, reproduced disagreement — it does not fix one. Keep this file as close to empty as the truth allows.
Schema: entries[] of { cp, stack?, reason }.
stack  — optional exact computed font-family string; omit to apply to every stack.
reason — REQUIRED, and must be a real sentence (>= 10 chars). Say what diverges and why living with it is defensible. The loader throws on a missing or perfunctory reason.
Every entry's hit count is written to report.json, so an entry that stops matching shows up as dead and can be deleted.
